title: Exploring Gender Biases in Language Patterns of Human-Conversational Agent Conversations

bias_targets.methodology: A mixed-methods approach involving: 1) Observational studies of user interactions with male- or female-voiced conversational agents (CAs) to qualitatively analyze gender-linked language use (e.g., affiliation, assertiveness), interactional patterns, and sentiment; 2) Online experiments using text analysis tools like LIWC to quantify emotions, femininity, masculinity, and power dynamics in human-CA chat histories; and 3) Lab experiments to test users' attitude and behavioral changes after interacting with gender-stereotypical versus counter-stereotypical CAs.
